node.statement: By the definition of a_n, ||T_n(Z^dagger dot Z)|| >= a_n||Z^dagger dot Z||; by lem-hcb3-uniform-square-lower, ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-K_sq*e)||Z||^2. Combining these inequalities with node #0 gives ||T_n(Z)||^2 >= [a_n(1-K_sq*e)-C_prod*e]||Z||^2 for every Z.
